CLARIN-D-metadata.Name: Kyrgyz Folklore Text Corpus
CLARIN-D-metadata.Title: Kyrgyz Folklore Text Corpus
CLARIN-D-metadata.Description: This corpus contains a curated collection of Kyrgyz folklore texts, including fairy tales, magical tales, tales of everyday life, proverbs, sayings, and aphorisms. The content was digitized from 5 academic volumes published in Bishkek between 2016 and 2017, sourced from the electronic collections of the Central Scientific Library of the National Academy of Sciences of the Kyrgyz Republic. The corpus is structured in plain text files with YAML front matter metadata—notably utilizing the Common Turkic Alphabet for titles—and includes 427,527 words total (338,937 in tales, 71,619 in proverbs, and 16,971 in aphorisms). Text extraction was performed via OCR and LLM processing, followed by strict human proofreading to guarantee accuracy and exclude any hallucinations.
